'''December 2000 Green Bay tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Hobbytown USA, Green Bay, Wisconsin on 9 December 2000. Dan won it. It is known from Matt Woleske's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1518">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-d-ii-endor-sealed-gb-12-9-00d1518/ d-ii-endor-sealed-gb-12-9-00], DeckTech (Matt "Ooryl_909" Woleske, 9 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-d-ii-endor-sealed-gb-12-9-00d1518/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Hobbytown USA, Green Bay, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Death Star II Closed Environment]]
* '''Winner:''' Dan
